title: Named roots of abandoned or parked open items (lapsed claims) are retained forever; no coordinator release exists, so the global cap fills
outcome: The global named-root cap cannot be filled indefinitely by roots nobody is using: roots of open items whose claims have lapsed become reclaimable through a supported, auditable route, without killing sessions.
acceptance: A root whose item has been open with no live claim for longer than a documented period (or which the coordinator explicitly releases through a documented, audited route) stops counting against the global cap, without killing any session and without changing the item's lifecycle.
Releasing such a root records who released it and why, and a later re-naming of that item works normally (a new generation; no stale evidence is credited).
Regression tests cover: a lapsed-claim open item's root becomes reclaimable; a live-claim item's root is never reclaimed; cargo test --bin termal is green.
